data.title: Data Scientist
data.description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Berlin, On-site
Top-of-Market Compensation - Exceptional commitment deserves exceptional reward

Most data scientists transition from research or academic work to production starting with dashboards and historical reporting. Here, you'll ship models that run live and shape what millions of users see every day. You'll take the rigor you've built in research and apply it to problems at scale. Your first 12 months compress what takes 3 years elsewhere.

You'll join a small team of people who have built and shipped ML systems at scale. You'll work on real problems from week one with the support to solve them. Show us you can own more, and we'll give you more.

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship models that predict user value, engagement, and reward behaviour. See them live in production.

  • Design and run A/B tests on offers, rewards, and ranking. Work out what actually caused the result through causal reasoning.

  • Build data infrastructure and measurement systems that let you reason rigorously about impact.

  • Own undefined product problems from first idea to production. No playbook. You own it all.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong Python and SQL. You use AI tools to move faster, and you still verify the output.

  • Research or academic background with proof of depth: published work, thesis, strong coursework, or competition results.

  • You get going on a vague problem without waiting for a spec, and you take it further than you were asked.

  • You quickly see which number matters and which question to answer first.

  • You think in causation and testable hypotheses. You debug rigorously when things break.

  • Bonus: Kaggle competition results, published papers, thesis work, or a system you built and hardened yourself.

Why Almedia

  • Grow at Almedia: profitable from launch, higher revenue per employee than Big Tech.

  • Sharp, small team: we keep it small on purpose, every hire raises the bar.

  • Equity: every Berlin employee gets a stake.

  • Top-of-market baseline. Deliver outlier impact, earn accordingly.

Small team, high bar. Growing at scale. If that sounds like home, apply.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €80K – €150K • Exceptional commitment deserves exceptional reward

data.title: Staff Data Scientist
data.description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Staff Data Scientist

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist with high ownership to work on meaningful challenges at scale.

You spot leverage points others miss: measurement systems that unlock pricing, experimentation infrastructure that multiplies output, causal models that rewrite unit economics. You own these end to end.

We value diverse technical lenses. Whether you are:

  • Causal inference specialist: propensity matching, DID, synthetic control, IV estimation. You turn observational chaos into rigorous insight.

  • Experimentation architect: designing multi-arm tests, MMM, MTA, uplift modelling. You define statistical rigor.

  • Systems thinker: building reward structures, pricing algorithms, ranking functions that balance engagement, conversion, and sustainable ROAS.

  • Zero to one builder: taking vague business questions into production data products.

What You'll Own

  • Measurement strategy. Design causal frameworks that reveal unit economics, attribution, and intervention impact. Own the gold standard documentation so others ship faster.

  • Experimentation infrastructure. Build platforms that enable rapid iteration and define statistical rigor without sacrificing speed.

  • High leverage models. Identify and own the models that move unit economics: pricing, ranking, user incentive systems. Partner with engineering to productionize rigorously.

  • Technical leadership. Mentor junior data scientists. Set the bar for how we think about causality, measurement, and trade offs. Drive clarity when stakeholders disagree.

  • Cross functional influence. Work alongside Product, Engineering, and Leadership to turn data insight into business action.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven autonomy. Track record moving unit economics through novel approaches. You own problems end to end.

  • Causal thinking. Deep experience with causal inference techniques (propensity matching, DID, synthetic control, IV estimation). You reason about causality, not just fit models.

  • Experimentation expertise. Led complex multi-arm experiments and designed or owned MMM, MTA, or uplift modelling systems. You understand type I and type II error costs.

  • Production maturity. Built and deployed models in product environments (Gaming, AdTech, user incentive systems preferred). You own metrics, monitoring, and decay.

  • Data engineering fluency. Comfortable with modern data stacks (dbt, Airflow, Kubernetes, Terraform). You architect alongside engineering, not just consume.

  • Communication and presence. Drive clarity in ambiguous situations. Translate complex analysis into decisions. Bring stakeholders along.

Why Almedia

  • Grow at Almedia: profitable from launch, higher revenue per employee than Big Tech.

  • Sharp, small team: we keep it small on purpose, every hire raises the bar.

  • Equity: every Berlin employee gets a stake.

  • Top of market baseline. Deliver outlier impact, earn accordingly.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

data.title: Projektleitung Versicherungs-Software (all Genders)
data.description:
Gegründet im Jahr 2002 und mit Standorten in München und Lissabon sind wir mit rund 45 Mitarbeitenden ein spezialisierter IT- und Beratungspartner für Krankenversicherungen und Beihilfestellen. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung standardisierter Softwarelösungen, kombiniert mit fundierter Branchenexpertise und effizienten Prozessen. Mit unseren Produkten und Dienstleistungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Komplexität zu reduzieren, Prozesse zu automatisieren und eine hochwertige Gesundheitsversorgung nachhaltig zu fördern

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle:

  • Leitung von IT-Projekten zur Implementierung von Softwarelösungen in der (Kranken-) Versicherungsbranche und Beihilfen
  • Verantwortung für die Projektplanung, -steuerung und -umsetzung unter Anwendung etablierter Projektmanagement-Methoden (z. B. IPMA, PMI oder PRINCE2)
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachabteilungen zur Sicherstellung einer passgenauen Umsetzung der Anforderungen
  • Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und externer Dienstleister
  • Identifikation und Management von Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Zielabweichungen
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Zeit-, Budget- und Qualitätsvorgaben

Qualifikation

Wer Du bist:

Ein wertschätzender Umgang mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen ist für Dich selbstverständlich. Du arbeitest gerne im Team, bringst eine positive Grundhaltung mit und übernimmst Verantwortung für eine vertrauensvolle und konstruktive Zusammenarbeit.

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Gesundheitsökonomie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 3 – 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der IT-Projektleitung, idealerweise im Versicherungs- oder Finanzumfeld
  • Nachgewiesene Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (z. B. PMP, PRINCE2)
  • Ausgeprägtes methodisches Know-how in klassischen und agilen Projektmanagement-Ansätzen
  • Gutes Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse und regulatorische Anforderungen in der Versicherungs- oder Finanzbranche
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Durchsetzungsvermögen und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sind selbstverständlich

Benefits

Unser Arbeitszeitmodell:

  • Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell mit hybrider Arbeitsweise.

  • Regelmäßige Präsenz am Standort München an mindestens zwei bis drei Tagen pro Woche, insbesondere zur Zusammenarbeit im Team und während der Einarbeitungsphase.

  • Kundenprojekte:

  • Je nach Projektphase und Kundenanforderung sind Vor-Ort-Termine bei unseren Kunden erforderlich.

  • Insbesondere während der Implementierungsphase kann die Reisetätigkeit zunehmen. Mehrtägige Kundeneinsätze mit Übernachtungen sind dabei durchaus üblich

Deine Benefits:

  • 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Dienstrad-Leasing
  • Deutschland-Ticket
  • Individuelles Ausbildungsbudget für Dein berufliches Wachstum
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events mit Spaßfaktor
  • Jährliche Unternehmenstage an der Algarve in Portugal
  • Jährlicher Team-Wiesn-Besuch

Bei GLOBAL SIDE erwarten Dich kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und ein Team, das Wert auf Vertrauen, Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung legt.

Als etabliertes Unternehmen mit über 20 Jahren Markterfahrung verbinden wir die Stabilität eines erfolgreichen Spezialisten mit der Dynamik und Flexibilität eines mittelständischen Unternehmens. Wir fördern Deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung und geben Dir den Freiraum, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

data.title: Staff Frontend Engineer / Frontend Architect (m/f/d)
data.description:
Introduction

Teaser

Two products, two backends, one frontend vision: build the AI-first frontend platform and design system that lets our engineers, product managers and designers ship UI at speed. A senior hands-on role with architect-level influence, no people management, and our CPTO as your executive sponsor.

Role at a glance

  • Level: Staff/Principal-level individual contributor – technical leadership, no direct reports
  • Reporting line: VP Engineering. Executive sponsor: our CPTO
  • Products: FactFinder NG (React on a Java backend) and Infinity (React on a .NET/F# backend)
  • Stack you'll shape: React, TypeScript, Web Components, design tokens, Storybook, AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • Team: Product & Technology organization of around 25 people, led by our CPTO, working in a product trio model with product and design
  • Location: Berlin; Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm possible – hybrid with 2–3 office days per week; occasional travel (<10%) for offsites and design-system workshops
  • Start: as soon as possible

About FactFinder

FactFinder is one of the leading product discovery platforms for European eCommerce. For more than 20 years we've applied AI and machine learning to product search, navigation, personalization and recommendations. Our Product Discovery Experience (PDX) spans two products: FactFinder NG, an exact and highly configurable search, and Infinity, a self-learning, behavioral discovery engine. More than 2,000 customers generate over €160 billion in annual GMV on our platform.

We're around 90 people with a new management team, a clear growth plan and reknown investors behind us. Right now we're rebuilding our product and tech organization around an AI-first way of working and agentic commerce – and this role sits at the center of it.

Why this role exists

Our two products run two React frontends with very different technical roots. We need a vision, an architect, and an owner — someone who will unify them into a single, efficient system, build the shared design system on top, and enable product managers and designers to prototype and ship production-grade UI themselves with AI tooling. Incrementally, without a big-bang rewrite, and while both products keep shipping.


Your mission

What you'll do

  • Define and drive the target frontend architecture across both React products – one consistent, efficient React-based system, migrated step by step
  • Build and own our shared design system: tokens, component library and Web Components for embeddable shop UI, tightly aligned with Product Design
  • Create an AI-first prototyping and contribution framework – design system, AI coding tools, guardrails, automated review and CI – so product managers and designers can prototype and contribute production-grade UI
  • Stay hands-on: write a significant share of the critical code, set standards, and pair with and level up our frontend engineers
  • Work with a clear operating split: after architecture-focused first stints, spend around 80% of your time hands-on coding and 20% on architecture, design-system leadership and enablement
What success looks like
  • After 90 days: frontend audit of both products done, target architecture and migration roadmap agreed, design-system tokens and core components live, and the first prototype built and shipped by a product manager or designer on the new framework
  • After 12 months: both products run on the shared design system, the frontend rework shows measurable efficiency gains, and product and design prototype independently as a routine – frontend is no longer the bottleneck


Your profile

Must-have

  • Expert-level React and TypeScript, proven in complex production SaaS frontends
  • A real AI-first engineering practice: you use AI coding tools and agents daily and have built workflows or frameworks that others use – not just "I use Copilot"
  • Design-system architecture: you've built or led a design system (tokens, component library, Storybook or similar) that was adopted across multiple teams or products
  • Web Components (Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, embedding in third-party environments) plus a frontend architecture track record: you've modernized or migrated a frontend stack at least once, ideally several times
  • 6+ years in frontend or software engineering, including 3+ years at Staff, Lead or Architect level – setting technical direction across teams, not just within your own
  • Hands-on today: you write production code yourself – this is not a concept-only architect position
  • Business-fluent English (C1); no formal degree required, your track record counts
Nice-to-have
  • Technical leadership without line management: you've led a SaaS frontend team through a major technology change
  • Meta-frameworks such as Next.js and/or Astro – and a clear view on when to use which
  • Design-to-code and prototyping tooling: Figma workflows, design-token pipelines, AI UI generation (v0, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • eCommerce, search or product discovery frontends (search UIs, embeddable shop widgets)
  • React on non-JavaScript backends (Java/Spring, .NET); Fable/Feliz or Ant Design
  • Good German language skills


Bonus Points

Who thrives here

  • Builders who ship code themselves and lead by example
  • Pragmatic simplifiers: incremental migration over big-bang rewrites, no over-engineering
  • Change agents with strong opinions, weakly held – able to transform an organization without burning it out
  • Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers
Probably not for you if you'd rather produce architecture concepts than running code, want to go deep on one product and leave the cross-product system to others, or are looking for a people-management role.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

What we offer

  • Real ownership with executive backing: you shape the frontend of two products end to end. You report to our VP Engineering; our CPTO is the executive sponsor of this role – both agree the target architecture and migration roadmap with you, and the CPTO reviews your 90-day goals and holds your final interview. A company-level priority, not a side project
  • AI-first as a leadership priority, with the tooling budget to match: Claude Code, Cursor or whatever makes you fastest
  • Impact without switching to management: a Staff/Principal IC track on our career ladder toward Principal/Distinguished – with the option to move into engineering management later if you want to
  • A product trio culture: engineering, product and design as co-owners, outcomes over outputs
  • Competitive compensation that reflects the Staff level of this role
  • Training and conference budget, 30 days of vacation, modern equipment, mobility offers and a company pension plan
  • Hybrid work with 2–3 office days per week in Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm

How we hire

Remote, with feedback within 48 hours after every step:

1. 30-minute intro call with our Recruiter Mirko
2. 60-minute technical interview with our VP Engineering (your future manager) and an engineering lead: one frontend modernization you led, your design-system story, and how you use AI day to day
3. Case study: a hands-on part (AI tools explicitly welcome – walk us through how you used them) and a 45-minute architecture session
4. Team panel and a 45-minute conversation with our CPTO – optionally on site

FAQ

Is this a people-management role? No. It's a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through architecture, standards and enablement, without direct reports.

Who will I report to? Our VP Engineering. The role is sponsored by our CPTO: the frontend platform is one of the CPTO's top priorities, you agree the target architecture and migration roadmap together, and the CPTO holds your final interview.

Which tech stack will I work with? React and TypeScript on both products. FactFinder NG runs on a Java backend, Infinity on .NET/F# (with Fable/Feliz on the frontend). Backend, F# and our search domain are things you can learn here – React expertise, Web Components, design-system architecture and AI-first practice are what you bring from day one.

Is "AI-first" real here, or a buzzword? It's driven by our CPTO and part of the career ladder for every engineer. Your mandate is to take it from individual productivity to organization-wide practice.

Two legacy frontends on Java and .NET – isn't that painful? That's exactly the mandate: unify them, and how is your call. Incremental, not big-bang.

Can I work fully remote? No – the role is hybrid with 2–3 office days per week at one of our offices.

Why eCommerce search? Because agentic commerce is where AI meets real purchase decisions – on our platform that's 2,000+ shops and €160+ billion in GMV a year.

Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile plus links to work you're proud of (GitHub, a design system, a talk, a blog post) – and tell us in three sentences how you use AI in your daily engineering work. No cover letter needed.

Your contact: Mirko Duus

data.title: ML Research Engineer
data.description:
We're looking for ML Engineers to join White Circle, an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems through natural-language policies it automatically tests, enforces, and improves at scale. Backed by $70M (Series A) from top funds and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, and others, White Circle processes 100M+ API calls monthly and fine-tunes and trains its own LLMs to run faster and cheaper than open or proprietary models.

You will

  • Turn petabytes of unstructured text into a structured, explorable view: topics, clusters, segments, trends, anomalies.

  • Build scalable representation pipelines: sampling, preprocessing, embeddings at scale, indexing, and retrieval.

  • Use LLMs for labeling, weak supervision, data enrichment, and automated diagnostics, with cost/quality controls.

  • Translate findings into product and operational decisions, and ship self-serve datasets, data models, and dashboards.

  • Work with engineering and research to align pipelines with production constraints (latency, cost, privacy).

Requirements

  • Strong Python and SQL, with production-grade pipeline engineering (not just notebooks).

  • Applied NLP/ML on real-world text: embeddings, clustering, topic modeling, semantic search, classification.

  • Experience at scale: distributed processing, large-scale storage and querying, performance-cost tradeoffs.

  • Evaluation of fuzzy problems: offline/online metrics, human-in-the-loop labeling, inter-annotator agreement, drift monitoring.

  • Prior work with safety/moderation datasets, policy/rule systems, or high-volume logging/observability.

  • Relocation to Paris or London (hybrid) required.

Bonus

  • Public builder footprint: open-source models, datasets, or frameworks on HuggingFace/GitHub, papers, or technical posts.

  • Experience at a frontier or near-frontier lab, or leading open-source model releases.

  • RL for LLMs beyond standard RLHF: online RL, GRPO-style methods.

  • Moderation, safety, or classification models at scale; multilingual model training.

We offer

  • Competitive salary + equity.

  • Hybrid work from central London or Paris office, relocation support for Paris after probation.

  • Premium private health insurance, mental health support, flexible time off.

  • Lunch and dinner covered in the office, L&D budget, all hardware and tools you need.

  • Team off-sites twice a year.
